method: Coordinator reviewed independent decisions and preserves first/follow-up/reviewer artifacts unchanged. Any coordinator overrides are recorded separately.

resolutions.reason: An edge-type legend explains how to read drawn edges; it does not say every observation path is drawn. The proposed trigger changes a type legend into a completeness promise without specific wording making that promise.

The Released column presents named cleanup calls as release facts, giving an exact local invitation to treat a requested call as an achieved cleanup outcome. This supports the cleanup part only. The gating-scope clause needs its own narrower analysis; the process-exit/reference lifetime sentences are A1.

The resource-specific table pairs mapping/preparation facts with bare_deny_default, supplying an organizational invitation to treat the named test as asserting every preparation fact. This is assertion coverage, not proof that a test was executed. The leading cleanup-lifetime fragment is A1 context.

No local statement describes the private apply routine transferring ownership or destroying the profile. A missing explicit PW destruction call is an actual absence, not a positive claim about what private apply does.

The normal launch observation, followed by the contaminated configuration, is the relevant local comparison. Freshness alone says nothing about a particular descriptor/environment arrangement. The actual configuration observations are A1 secondary propositions.

The adjoining affirmative signal-inheritance account and link to inheritance controls can invite reading the observer as independently establishing the worker-to-child signal state. The guard explains why its own ignored SIGPIPE defeats that reading.

The positive report that failed initialization reaches later invalid-handle uses is the exact premise that could be read as an observation of libc accepting or rejecting that input. The adapters qualification prevents that extension; the other failure-flow observations remain A1.
The specific low-descriptor launch observations, not the word fresh, invite generalization to an ordinary launch.

Fresh worker denotes one process per specimen and is immediately paired with already-present libraries/process context. Neither freshness nor the listed endpoint/environment observations promise a full signal, Mach-right, private-runtime or effective-authority census. Some individual observation-generalization clauses have narrower C2 counterparts (N012/N122); do not let those establish C2 for the whole census claim.

The action table positively describes opened/written/created resources and labels a published success. That specific status/effect presentation can invite treating source call descriptions or status as independently witnessed filesystem effects. The caption alone was too broad.

The positive Apple-source allocation and fallback-buffer claims provide exact local triggers. Fixed PW buffers alone would not invite every claimed allocator/locale/binding inference. The allocation/source-versus-installed distinction is well supported; detailed locale/binding state still has weaker local prompting.

A named descriptor-ceiling and bare-deny path is an actual positive control account. It can be generalized to all profiles/environments or all setup properties; the guard scopes the result to the case and separates source placement.

Null stdin, captured output and leader observation do not invite the exact inference that a nonzero child exit negates successful spawn. The proposed trigger discusses lifecycle setup, whereas the guard distinguishes the result of spawning from the result of the spawned program. A conventional process-success conflation is hypothetical external context.

The source says a bootstrap reference is retained, but does not claim a live right count. A generic cited test/definition is not a positive measurement claim. The exact inference that a native right-count measurement occurred lacks a local trigger.

This occurrence concerns the issuer/host’s own allocation, handle, cleanup, source/observation provenance or internal state. It does not itself assert what the worker receives, holds, does, can inherit or cannot access. Membership in the worker-capability map does not turn it into a worker proposition. Keep it as explicit excluded supporting-apparatus context; do not force it into B1 instead.
The before/during/after-release fresh-read sequence is a concrete local invitation to interpret the final read as a required revocation check; accepting either result blocks exactly that reading.

The release/read sequence supports revocation and permission overreading; the static extension handle/native state wording supports handle-to-kernel-state overreading. Neither by itself supports every stable-identity or private-allocation claim. Preserve the mixed unit visibly: revocation/state parts have C2 triggers; stable identity/private allocation need separate trigger decisions rather than inheriting the bucket automatically.

Completed-slot publication and host decoding are concrete local premises for the absent-publication/absent-effect mistake. The created-file observation refutes that inference; payload eligibility itself is also A1 protocol behavior.

Use the immediate affirmative claim about existing storage and the concentration of PW dynamic acquisitions, not the generic earlier static-buffer inventory. The exact possible overreading extends PW call-site acquisition behavior into native/library internals.
Closing collection before worker release establishes ordering, and directly invites an overstrong stable-snapshot reading across later attempts.
The quoted proposition describes an actual worker resource, interface, lifecycle, implementation restriction or absence. Its negative wording is not by itself an interpretive guard.

The completed-publication protocol supplies the exact local premise for treating an absent report as no effect. Moving assembly into the worker is a separate A1 design counterfactual already visible in the unit.

The positive query-before-release arrangement is an exact local trigger for a stable-snapshot overreading. The counterfactual about removing the hold is separately A1 implementation/experiment behavior.

The resource-row source/check pairing is exactly the structure whose stronger semantic-coverage interpretation this passage limits. The source-review completeness sentence is broader and should retain its own scope.
The gap-index summary inherits N020’s census boundary, not a new trigger. Freshness does not assert complete instrumentation, isolation or effective-authority measurement.

The relevant local material is the extension state-carrying handle and erasure account, not unrelated fixed-capacity policy/input storage. These invite overextending PW-visible state and erasure to private state. Private allocation extent is still a distinct weaker part.
The concrete per-row source/check pairing can be overread as verified semantic assertion coverage; the guard expressly limits that stronger inference. No claim about historical origin follows.
